patches.decision_note: Publication and categorization are independently actionable: message 240 establishes temporary and later corrective categorization, while message 264 claims listing completion without establishing final categorization.
Candidate-property selection changes independently from message delivery, and the outreach template can fail while host selection remains unaffected.

replacement.title: HubSpot Contact Property Configuration
replacement.definition: Configure the required HubSpot contact properties and form fields needed to create complete lead records.

patches.decision_note: The missing required fields and inability to configure HubSpot properties describe a CRM-schema behavior distinct from the rule governing when secured leads enter HubSpot.
The message changes listing-workflow timing but does not change the spreadsheet artifact, its fields, or its record organization.

Message 178 claims completion of an additional-profile correction, suggesting that message 176 may contain a missing client-authoritative MODIFY for Pinterest Task 1; its verbatim source is needed before adding the Event.
The scope of the earlier prohibition on AI must be resolved before deciding whether it defines a task-local constraint separate from the later explicitly AI-assisted content Requirements.
